verdict.rationale: Linear documents a first-party Linear Agent that can 'analyze feedback in bulk', and its homepage says users can delegate entire issues end-to-end, which suggests agent-driven operation. Neither source explicitly describes issuing natural-language commands to operate the product. The MCP server only lets external agents act on Linear, which is a developer building block and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a natural-language command interface, the breadth of actions the Linear Agent can perform, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
